msg.none: No practice planned this week. Enjoy the time together.
msg.notStarted: A few minutes together is a great start.
msg.started: Good start. Every little bit of practice helps.
msg.halfway: More than halfway there. Lovely work.
msg.complete: All done for this week. Thank you for practising together.

list.emptyBody: When {{name}}'s therapist adds an activity to try at home, it will appear here with simple steps.
list.noChildBody: Once the school links your child to your account, home practice will appear here.
list.feedbackSubtitle: What the therapists said about your practice
list.resourcesHint: Shared by your child's therapists and school

task.historyEmpty: No practice logged yet. Your first log will appear here.
task.archiveBody: The family will no longer see it in their Practice tab. Past logs and feedback are kept.

log.title: Log practice
log.notePlaceholder: For example: he enjoyed the song part and asked for more.
log.noteHelper: Tip: tap the microphone on your keyboard to speak instead of typing.
log.needChoices: Please choose how it went and how hard it was.
log.waitVideo: Getting the video ready. This takes a few seconds.
log.savedBody: Thank you. {{name}}'s therapist will see this.
log.savedVideo: Saved. The video will upload in the background. You can close the app.
log.savedVideoWifi: Saved. The video will upload when you're on Wi-Fi.
log.savedOffline: Saved on this phone. It will send when you're online.

video.title: Short video (optional)
video.hint: Up to 60 seconds. Videos are private: only your child's therapists can watch them, and they are deleted automatically later.
video.compressing: Making the video smaller to save data… {{percent}}%
video.error: This video couldn't be played right now.
video.privateRetention: Private video. Deleted automatically after {{days}} days.
video.consentOff: Video sharing is turned off for your account, so only your notes are sent.
video.permissionBody: To record a short practice video, the app needs your camera. Videos stay private between you and your child's therapists.

problem.too_long: This video is longer than 60 seconds. Please record a shorter clip. 30 to 60 seconds is perfect.
problem.too_large: This video is still too large to send, even after making it smaller. Please try a shorter clip.
problem.failed: We couldn't use this video. Please try again or choose another one.
problem.camera_denied: The camera wasn't allowed. You can try again, or choose a video from your gallery.
problem.camera_blocked: Camera access is turned off for this app. You can turn it on in Settings, or choose a video from your gallery.

uploads.title: Sending your practice
uploads.offline: Saved on this phone. Will send when you're online.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.emptyBody: New practice updates and videos from families will appear here.

entry.useInSession: Use this video in the next session

entry.chooseReaction: Choose a quick reaction to send
entry.sent: Feedback sent. Here's the next one.
entry.allDone: Feedback sent. You're all caught up.
entry.awaitingFeedback: The therapist will look at this soon.
entry.flaggedForSession: Will be used in the next session
